topic.title: Rural Exception Sites / First Homes Exception Sites / Local Need
topic.source_contract: rural settlement context, exception-site policy route, local housing need, tenure mix, First Homes criteria, proportionality, viability, planning obligation, construction, occupation and long-term affordability evidence

scope_guards: An unallocated rural site is not automatically a rural exception site.
A housing need survey is not treated as planning permission.
First Homes policy eligibility is not treated as an executed discount covenant.
A viability appraisal is not treated as an agreed market-housing proportion.
An outline permission is not treated as completed affordable homes.
A completed dwelling is not treated as occupied by an eligible household.
Initial occupation is not treated as long-term affordability compliance.
No score or promotion is written without exact site, consent, covenant, construction, occupation and monitoring evidence.
